title: pointer.link
description: Git-native join. Sibling of TypedEdge, not a subtype. Field name is link_type, not rel. One file, exactly two ends. Destination may be unresolved at write time. Links do not record the taxonomy version they were written against.

source.description: Identifier of the source noun. Not mutated.

destination.description: Identifier of the destination noun. A list here is several Links and fails validation. May not resolve locally.

link_type.description: Value from the Pointers taxonomy. Not a TypedEdge rel. Unknown values fail closed. Every type declares an inverse.
